summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Flavouria's recent additions. Backend: 94/94 pytest tests pass (added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py covering GET /api/youtube top-3 + AI fields + cache, /api/youtube/save toggle & /api/youtube/saved persistence/per-user isolation/auth, /api/explore pagination & edge cases, all 11 nav dropdown queries, creator dashboard payload, search-terms vocab, recipe detail steps). Frontend: navbar (World of Recipes, Best Indian Cuisines->Bengali, Healthy Easy Food->Salads, mobile sheet), search skeletons -> Top-3 YouTube cards with embedded video/ingredients/method/why-tag/AI summary, Cook Mode from BOTH YouTube card (Step 1 of 10 -> Next works) and community recipe (/recipe/creamy-butter-chicken, next+prev+close), Save-from-YouTube end-to-end (toast 'Saved to your collection' -> /saved 'Saved from YouTube' section -> unsave removes), More Recipes reveal (6 cards) + Load more (12), creator dashboard search filter + share buttons, and biriyani->Biryani fuzzy regression. Cook Mode overlay DOES render in the DOM and works. 3 UI defects found (1 overlay/pointer-events blocking, 1 stale search input, 1 explore relevance).

ui_bugs.issue: The ingredients panel is 'absolute inset-0' inside the cook-mode container, so it covers the header. While it is open, the header 'Ingredients' toggle (cook-mode-ingredients) and the exit button (cook-mode-close) are un-clickable - Playwright reports 'cook-mode-ingredients-panel intercepts pointer events' (30s timeout). Also the panel's own close X button has no data-testid, so the only working exit is an untestable button.

SearchBar uses `initial={query}` as one-time useState seed, so after in-app navigation (nav dropdown click, e.g. /search?q=Bengali -> Juice) the input still shows the OLD query while the H1/results show the new one. Reproduced: heading='Juice', input='Bengali'.
Several distinct recipes reuse the identical thumbnail image (Rajma Masala, Dal Makhani, Kadai Chicken all show the same 4-bowl photo) - looks like placeholder/duplicated seed imagery.

integration_issues.issue: Query 'butter chicken' returns clearly irrelevant community recipes (Molten Chocolate Cake, Classic Chocolate Fudge Cake, Steamed Chicken Momos, Awadhi Chicken Biryani) because /api/explore ORs every token across title/tags/cuisine/region/category/ingredients.name with no AND/scoring. Functionally works, but UX quality is poor.

issues: Two console 401 errors on every anonymous load (GET /api/auth/me and /api/youtube/saved probes) - harmless but noisy in DevTools; consider suppressing/short-circuiting when no auth cookie is present.

action_items: CookMode: give the ingredients panel its own layer that does not cover the header (e.g. render it below the header / inset-top or lower z-index), and add data-testid="cook-mode-ingredients-close" to the panel's X button so the panel can be toggled/closed from the header.
Search page: sync SearchBar value with the `q` search param (useEffect on query, or key={query}) so the input never shows a stale query after nav-dropdown navigation.
Optional: tighten /api/explore matching (require the full phrase or score-rank tokens) so 'butter chicken' does not surface chocolate cakes.
Optional: replace duplicated/placeholder recipe thumbnails in seed data.
critical_code_review_comments: CookMode.jsx: the ingredients overlay uses `absolute inset-0` inside the same container as the header - this is the direct cause of the pointer-event interception; the header controls must stay above it.
Search.jsx useEffect depends on [query, user]; when the user object identity changes the whole YouTube fetch re-runs and skeletons flash again. Consider depending on user?.id.
SearchBar `initial` prop is only used as the useState seed - a classic derived-state bug; sync via useEffect.
Search.jsx loadMore() uses `more.length` as skip; if the underlying list changes between pages, items can duplicate/skip. Prefer an explicit page counter.
server.py /api/explore builds an unbounded $or regex list (6 clauses per token + whole query) - fine for seed size, but should be replaced by a text index for scale.
youtube_save accepts an unvalidated raw dict body and stores it verbatim - add a Pydantic model to bound field sizes/types.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is /app/backend/tests/ (94 tests, all pass; pytest.ini runs -n 2 --dist loadscope - do not modify). test_new_features.py covers youtube/explore/nav-queries/creator-dashboard. YouTube results are cached ~3h per query, so 'butter chicken' and 'biryani' now return in <2s; a brand-new query can take 20-40s so use timeout>=120s when waiting for top-three-card-1. Known open UI bugs: ingredients panel blocks header buttons, stale SearchBar value after in-app nav.
rca_of_the_issue: CookMode ingredients panel: rendered as a sibling `absolute inset-0` div inside the same relative/fixed cook-mode container as the header, so it paints over the header and swallows all pointer events for cook-mode-ingredients and cook-mode-close; only the panel's own (untestable) X closes it. SearchBar stale value: `useState(initial)` seeds once; React Router keeps the same component mounted across /search?q=X -> /search?q=Y transitions so the state is never re-seeded.
